		"tr_ap_discovery_faith_in_science"
	}

	ai_weight = {
		factor = 20
		modifier = {
			factor = 5
			years_passed < 20
		}
		modifier = {
			factor = 2
			has_ethic = ethic_materialist
		}
		modifier = {
			factor = 3
			has_ethic = ethic_fanatic_materialist
		}
		modifier = {
			factor = @ap_pending_tradition_suppress
			has_ap_pending = yes
		}
	}
	potential = { NOT = { has_country_flag = ap_ai } NOT = { has_country_flag = ap_vanilla_traditions } OR = { has_tradition = tr_ap_discovery_adopt ap_tree_slot_free = yes } }
}
